sources: Owner-approved Saraswati twin cities plan, 14 November 2026
name: Two Waters in One Cove

levels.entry: The cove tastes of salt at its outer edge.
Fresh river water enters above the mangrove roots.
Different plants hold the fresher channel and the saline margin.
A cove is several habitats meeting. Keeping the freshwater inlet open matters more than making every bank look alike.
